row.notes: Reads the entry name (key hash 0x0fe07306) from the packed descriptor, extends pathStr as "%hs.%hs", reads flag key 0x47b0fbf7, finds the child of *parentHandle whose +0x20 hash equals djb2(name), or creates it with Vm_Node_CreateGroupChildByHash and registers it with FUN_1442b6740(nodeAlloc, tag, &handle). Calls the callback ctx+0x08 (user ctx+0x10) with (handle, path). Then walks the keyed child table at key 0x871f67c3 (entries 8 or 0xc bytes), reads each child's type string (key 0xd34355db) and dispatches to itself, 0x1442b9ef0 or 0x1442bb420. Returns 0 or an error code (0x16 null parent, 3 key missing) and releases pathStr. Vm_Parse_DbTypeDescriptor does the same three-way dispatch for top-level entries; 0x1442b9ef0 calls it for nested entries. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
